name: ModernNoCupboardDecay
title: Modern No Cupboard Decay
author: Gabriel Dungan (DunganSoft Technologies)
description: Prevents decay within Tool Cupboard radius. Wipe-aware UI, team-aware auth, debug overlay, and TC preview holograms. Oxide v2.0.7022+ (Rust Naval Update); verified against Oxide 2.0.7423.

permissions.name: modernnocupboarddecay.admin
permissions.description: Use /mncdset, /mncdui, /mncduiadd and /mncdresetui to change settings and move the wipe UI.

permissions.name: modernnocupboarddecay.debug
permissions.description: Use /mncddebug to toggle the personal protection-status overlay.

permissions.name: modernnocupboarddecay.preview
permissions.description: Use /mncdpreview to draw TC protection rings (enforced only when PreviewRequiresPermission is true).

commands.description: Show help (topics: basic, ui, set, debug, preview, wipe).
Admin: live configuration (radius, auth, wipe mode).
Admin: set the wipe-UI panel anchors.
